title: Captain Project Memory Epoch Envelope v1
description: Parking contract for fail-closed project-scoped memory/context. Local integration remains unverified until reconciled on the Captain laptop.

repo_scope_hash.description: Canonical non-reversible repository-scope hash; never a raw local path.

x-captain-read-policy.authority: chat_id + project_id + repo_scope_hash + current Project State state_epoch must exactly match
x-captain-read-policy.on_missing_malformed_or_stale_authority: deny and return no project-scoped memory/context
x-captain-read-policy.no_fallback: never fall back to another project, repository, previous epoch, or unscoped namespace
x-captain-read-policy.context_injection: Project State and Project Memory injected into an LLM turn must originate from the same current epoch
x-captain-read-policy.non_project_chat: ordinary non-project chat remains supported without synthesizing a project epoch

x-captain-write-policy.commit_time_revalidation: revalidate full authority immediately before persistence so an in-flight stale write cannot land after an epoch change
x-captain-write-policy.legacy_records: project-scoped records lacking a valid epoch are legacy-stale; do not bulk-upgrade or implicitly copy them into a new epoch
x-captain-write-policy.credential_gate: retain existing credential-like content rejection and secret-safe audit behavior

x-captain-required-regressions: current full authority reads current project memory
epoch change makes prior memory/context inaccessible
in-flight old-epoch write is rejected after epoch change
missing or malformed epoch fails closed
context assembler cannot inject stale project memory after epoch change
new epoch does not implicitly inherit old-epoch project memory
normal non-project chat remains functional without state_epoch
